plan.notes: BA in Theatre. Official Monmouth College 'Academic Plan' (sample plan). One Monmouth course credit = 4 credit-hours; credits modeled in Monmouth course credits exactly as printed. The plan places major courses and first-year Core Foundations; remaining credits each term are filled with Core Requirements or general electives per the plan's instructions (those fillers are not modeled). Italics in the source indicate prerequisites exist - see the catalog for chains; not modeled here. 'Or' rows occupying one slot are modeled as single choice slots. Flexible 'take in either term' rows are modeled in the first-listed term and documented. Pages undated (retrieved 2026-10-09); catalog_year labeled 2026-2027. Degree requires 31 course credits; 11 major credits. 'THEA 250 or 275' is printed in both Year 2 Fall and Year 3 Fall (take once; modeled in Year 2 Fall). THEA 300 is printed 'or in Junior Year'; THEA 377, 406, 285, 325 are printed 'or in Senior Year' - modeled in the first-listed terms. THEA 171/176 meet the Artistic Inquiry Core requirement; THEA 174 meets the Quantitative Reasoning in Practice Core requirement; THEA 285 meets Artistic Inquiry and Community Engagement; THEA 325 meets Artistic Inquiry and Global Learning.
